text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Hyaa, the "Monster the Second" is as incredible as ever!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky-san and I have different running styles and strengths, but... there's just something about her that completely captivates you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, with Maruzensky-san gone,
the only one who can hype up the Twinkle Series is definitely that girl—

text_block_list.name: Child in the Audience
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder-saaaan!!
Great job in the Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Child in the Audience
text_block_list.text:
That thunderous, powerful, and straightforward way of running
is so cool--!!

text_block_list.name: Child in the Audience
text_block_list.text:
Dad, Dad!
I wanna go watch the next race too!!

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oho... I see, I see.
You've become quite the fan of hers, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Child in the Audience
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!! Grass Wonder-san...
I wonder what kind of run we'll get to see next...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder, huh...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer.
choice_data_list: That was a great race, Grass!
That was a great race, Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I won't claim there are no areas to improve.
However, I have no regrets."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I have shown everything I am capable of right now.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"All that remains is to keep pressing forward—
and show the world the next version of myself."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Now THAT is what I'm talking abooout!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, El~...
I had a feeling you'd show up, and here you are.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Naturally! It goes without saaaaying!
I watched you, Grass!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And that made me certain, desu!
Once more—no, anew!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder!
I knew it—unless I overcome you,
I can never take flight into the world!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And so, now is the time!!
I challenge you to a duel, Grass!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —At the Mainichi Okan!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"The Mainichi Okan... a GⅡ race?
My, I thought you would choose a more prominent stage."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! This year's Mainichi Okan is special!
After all, *the* "Otherworldly Escapist" is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka-senpai is scheduled to participate, YES-DEES!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Suzuka-senpai is?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka—an Umamusume who is
a bit of a senior to Grass Wonder and the others—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She blows the competition away right from the start and
maintains the lead the entire way—this runaway front-runner
is the powerhouse everyone's talking about!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see.
That sounds like it will be a truly precious race.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Right!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"The Peerless Front-Runner," Silence Suzuka!
"The Azure Fiend of Tenacity," Grass Wonder!
"The World's Strongest," El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The day of the showdown is this autumn in Fuchu, at the Mainichi Okan!!
Now—accept my challenge, Grass!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...I will simply continue to move forward steadily.
Without straying, without wavering, aiming for the pinnacle."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if something stands before my eyes,
I shall overcome it. No matter what it is, no matter who it is.”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Even if that person is you. ...El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Excelente!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then we cannot stand idly by desu!
Training! Traaaaining!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well then, here we go!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah. Please wait, El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Using the confusion to sneak that in...
Who are you calling a demon, exactly?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Kyahiik!?
My tail hurts, it hurts it hurts, Grasssss!!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Both Grass-chan and El-chan
are amazing, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Even today, I—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Good work today, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san!?
Waaah~!! You came to watch me!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I just happened to have some errands nearby,
and then I remembered Spe-chan was running...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah, thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I didn't really get to show you
my best side... ehehe.
I even lost to Grass-chan, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Oh right, speaking of Grass-chan!
Suzuka-san, you're slated to run in the Mainichi Okan, right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's on my rotation schedule, but... why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I overheard Grass-chan and the others
talking over there just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I hear both El and Grass are aiming
for the Mainichi Okan!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...! That's right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I see... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...? Um, Suzuka-san?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'm sorry, I couldn't help myself.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I watched Grass-san run from up above too,
so I'm really looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of view lies ahead of those girls, at the very front...
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'm sorry for rambling on when you're tired.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to head out now.
I'll be waiting in the dorms, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, see you later.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Looking forward to seeing what lies ahead... huh.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...If it were me running beside you,
would you feel the same way...?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Even today, I... don't feel like
I was able to properly compete against Grass-chan, and yet..."
